/*master.mpif.selectMasterMpIfSecItemInfoList*/
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT A.KEP_SEQ ,A.SYS_CODE ,A.PROCESS_TYPE ,A.VENDOR ,A.REQ_NO ,A.VENDOR_REQ_NO ,A.ITEM_CODE ,A.CATEGORY_ID AS CATEGORY_NO ,(SELECT CATEG_NAME FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRSAMSG001' AND STD_CATEG_ID = A.CATEGORY_ID ) AS CATEGORY_TEXT ,A.ITEM_NAME ,A.MODEL_NO ,A.MANUFACTURER_BIZ_NO ,A.MANUFACTURER ,A.MAKER_NAME ,(SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = NVL(C.ORIGIN_CODE, B.ORIGIN_CODE) ) AS ORIGIN_NAME ,NVL(C.MAKER_CODE, B.MAKER_CODE) AS MAKER_CODE ,NVL(C.ORIGIN_CODE, B.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_CODE ,A.SPECIFICATION ,A.SYM ,A.IMAGE_URL ,A.DETAIL_URL ,A.VENDOR_ITEM_CODE AS CMS_CATLG_ID ,A.NEED_COMMENTS ,A.COMPANY_CODE ,A.INCOTERMS ,A.CURRENCY ,A.UNIT_CODE AS UNIT_MEASURE ,A.ORDER_UNIT ,A.MOQ ,A.VAT ,A.UNIT_PRICE ,A.PRICE_START_DT ,A.PRICE_END_DT ,A.CLOSE_YN ,A.CLOSE_DT ,A.LEAD_TIME ,A.PURCHASE_PIC ,A.PURCHASE_TEL ,A.PURCHASE_MAIL ,A.SALES_PIC ,A.SALES_TEL ,A.SALES_MAIL ,A.ITEM_COL01 ,A.ITEM_COL02 ,A.ITEM_COL03 ,A.ITEM_COL04 ,A.ITEM_COL05 ,A.ITEM_COL06 ,A.ITEM_COL07 ,A.ITEM_COL08 ,A.ITEM_COL09 ,A.ITEM_COL10 ,A.MAIN_IMAGE_URL ,A.TAXABLE ,A.IF_FLAG ,A.IF_DATE ,A.CREATE_DATE ,A.IF_MSG ,A.RESULT_FLAG ,CASE WHEN A.IF_FLAG = 'E' THEN '2' ELSE CASE WHEN NVL(A.RESULT_FLAG, ' ') = 'Y' THEN '0' WHEN NVL(A.RESULT_FLAG, ' ') = 'N' THEN '2' ELSE '1' END END AS RESULT_FLAG_IMG ,DECODE( CASE WHEN TRIM(B.IMGFILE_NAME) IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(B.IMGFILE_NAME) WHEN TRIM(C.IMGFILE_NAME) IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(C.IMGFILE_NAME) WHEN TRIM(D.IMGFILE_NAME) IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(D.IMGFILE_NAME) ELSE '' END ,'','7','8') AS IMGFILE_NAME_IMG ,CASE WHEN TRIM(B.IMGFILE_NAME) IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(B.IMGFILE_NAME) WHEN TRIM(C.IMGFILE_NAME) IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(C.IMGFILE_NAME) WHEN TRIM(D.IMGFILE_NAME) IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(D.IMGFILE_NAME) ELSE '' END AS IMGFILE_NAME ,CASE WHEN TRIM(B.IMGFILE_DIR) IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(B.IMGFILE_DIR) WHEN TRIM(C.IMGFILE_DIR) IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(C.IMGFILE_DIR) WHEN TRIM(D.IMGFILE_DIR) IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(D.IMGFILE_DIR) ELSE '' END AS IMGFILE_DIR ,DECODE(A.MAIN_IMAGE_URL,'X','7','8') AS PREVIEW_IMG ,A.RESULT_MSG ,B.BUYER_ITEM_NO ,C.BUYER ,C.QUOTATION_NO ,C.QUOTATION_SEQ ,C.REVISION ,DECODE(C.CANCEL_REMARK,'',10,9) AS CANCEL_REMARK_IMG ,C.CANCEL_REMARK ,A.PM_GUBUN, A.PM_BUYER, A.PM_NO, A.PM_SEQ ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.PROCESS_TYPE, A.VENDOR_ITEM_CODE, A.ITEM_CODE, A.COMPANY_CODE ORDER BY A.KEP_SEQ DESC) AS RNUM FROM EAI.IF_SEC_ITEM_INFO_SEND A , ICOMBYIT B , KEPRQDT C , CMSCATLG D
WHERE 1 = 1
AND A.REQ_NO LIKE trim(#{st_req_no}) || '%'
AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE trim(#{st_buyer_item_no}) || '%'
AND B.CMS_CATLG_ID LIKE trim(#{st_cms_catlg_id}) || '%'
AND A.COMPANY_CODE LIKE trim(#{st_company_code}) || '%'
AND A.CREATE_DATE BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{st_from_date},'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(#{st_to_date},'YYYYMMDD') + 1
AND A.PROCESS_TYPE = #{st_process_type}
AND A.PM_NO = #{st_pm_no}
AND A.VENDOR_REQ_NO LIKE #{st_vendor_req_no} || '%'
AND '1' = CASE WHEN 'Y' = #{st_result} AND A.RESULT_FLAG = 'Y' THEN '1' WHEN 'N' = #{st_result} AND A.RESULT_FLAG = 'N' THEN '1' WHEN 'T' = #{st_result} AND A.RESULT_FLAG IS NULL THEN '1' WHEN 'E' = #{st_result} AND ((A.RESULT_FLAG IS NULL AND A.IF_FLAG = 'E') OR A.RESULT_FLAG = 'E')THEN '1' ELSE '0' END
AND A.IF_FLAG != 'D' AND 'KRSAMSG001' = B.BUYER AND A.VENDOR_ITEM_CODE = B.CMS_CATLG_ID AND B.BUYER_ITEM_NO = CASE WHEN A.PROCESS_TYPE = 'RETURN_NEW_ITEM' THEN C.BUYER_ITEM_NO ELSE NVL(A.ITEM_CODE, A.VENDOR_ITEM_CODE) END AND ( 'KRSAMS0123' = C.BUYER(+) OR 'KRSAMS0192' = C.BUYER(+)) AND SUBSTR(A.REQ_NO, 1, 20) = C.QUOTATION_NO(+) AND SUBSTR(A.REQ_NO, 21, 25) = C.QUOTATION_SEQ(+) AND A.VENDOR_ITEM_CODE = D.CMS_CATLG_ID
AND A.PURCHASE_PIC IN (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{st_suser_id} UNION ALL SELECT USER_NAME_ENG FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{st_suser_id})
) WHERE RNUM = 1 ORDER BY KEP_SEQ desc
mapper.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_SEC_ITEM_INFO_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'D' , IF_MSG = #{P_MSG}||IF_MSG WHERE VENDOR_REQ_NO = #{VENDOR_REQ_NO}

INSERT INTO ICOMTRXL VALUES ('SEC_ITEM', NVL(#{TARGET},' '), NVL(#{KEY_1},' '), NVL(#{KEY_2},' '), NVL(#{KEY_3},' '), NVL(#{KEY_4},' '), NVL(#{KEY_5},' '), NVL(#{KEY_6},' '), NVL(#{KEY_7},' '), NVL(#{KEY_8},' '), NVL(#{KEY_9},' '), NVL(#{KEY_10},' '))

UPDATE KEPRQDT SET ATOB_UNIT_PRICE = 0 , SND_CHK = 'N' , SND_DATM = NULL , ATOB_SEND_FLAG = 'N' , ATOB_DATE = NULL , ATOB_TIME = NULL , REJECT_REMARK = #{st_user_name_loc} || ' - 품목IF재견적 처리' || ' / ' || (SELECT MAX(RESULT_MSG) FROM EAI.IF_SEC_ITEM_INFO_SEND WHERE VENDOR_REQ_NO = #{VENDOR_REQ_NO}) , RECV_FLAG = 'GA' , BUYER_ITEM_NO = CASE WHEN BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE 'NO_CODE%' THEN 'NO_CODE' ELSE BUYER_ITEM_NO END , CONTRACT_NO = NULL , CONTRACT_SEQ = NULL WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} AND QUOTATION_NO = #{QUOTATION_NO} AND QUOTATION_SEQ = #{QUOTATION_SEQ} AND REVISION = #{REVISION} AND STATUS IN ('C','R')

UPDATE KEPRQDT /*deleteQuotReceipt*/ SET RECV_FLAG = 'GD' , CANCEL_USER_ID = #{USR_ID} /*CANCEL_USER_ID*/ , CANCEL_DATE = SYSDATE , CANCEL_REMARK = #{CANCEL_REMARK} /*CANCEL_REMARK*/ , SND_CHK = 'N' , SND_DATM = NULL WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} /*BUYER*/ AND QUOTATION_NO = #{QUOTATION_NO} /*QUOTATION_NO*/ AND QUOTATION_SEQ = #{QUOTATION_SEQ} /*QUOTATION_SEQ*/ AND REVISION = #{REVISION} /*REVISION*/ AND STATUS IN ('C','R')
